instagram.caption:
Fortnite's Battle Royale mode was built in about two months.

Fortnite launched in July 2017 as a zombie defense game that had been in the works for six years. Then PUBG exploded, and Epic rushed out a free side mode that September.

It reached 10 million players in two weeks and became the whole game.
